svg.text: How Ask finds and checks an answer
Permissions come first, then the search, then a check of every fact before you see it.
You do
Workbench does
Your question
In your own words. Typos are fine.
Who is asking?
Your access is applied first. People
on the private list are never read,
and if that list can't load, it
stops.
Find the records
Follows the links from the order to
its emails, files and other systems.
Write a draft answer
Every fact must point to a record.
Check every fact
Each one is compared with its
source. A fact that doesn't match is
removed.
Show disagreements
If two systems differ, both are
shown, with the reason one was used.
Say what's missing or
hidden
Missing data is named. Things you
may not open are counted, never
described.
General knowledge,
labelled
Questions like "what is FEFO" get a
plain answer under its own heading,
with no company facts.
